content.short: Multichain domain name service with 248,000 names across 50+ EVM chains, plus a token launchpad.
content.description: ZNS Connect lets users register a domain name on more than 50 EVM networks, including Base, Ink, Soneium and Unichain, use it as an on-chain identity, and share in revenue. More than 248,000 domains are held by 182,000 owners. It also runs airdrop campaigns and a launchpad that deploys memecoins on Uniswap v4 with permanently locked liquidity, giving creators up to half of LP fees.
content.meta: Register a Web3 domain on 50+ chains with ZNS Connect, now with 248K names, airdrops and a locked-LP launchpad.
